notes: Both new paths rotate only estimated main, leave estimated image unchanged, then solve corrected Gaussian posterior.
Full S=A C A^T+noise is held at original A when scoring mean phase hypotheses. Scalar is same trace/d. Exact whole-action path separately models rotated covariance.
No use of source V to fit or select anything. All true TX scoring is separate after fixed outputs. Formal queued matrix stays as preregistered.
